coordinate_system: beam z longitudinal; x along width or twin center spacing; y along section height

layout_snapshot.load_context: Section loads below are chosen sensitivity inputs, not loads derived from this kinematic model.

material.moduli_status: Published guidance values, not certified material tolerance intervals
material.yield_scope: Thyssenkrupp extruded profiles/tubes t<=5 mm; Hydro T6/T6511 extrusions t<=6.30 mm: Rp0.2 >=240 MPa. Selected wall=3 mm. No upper bound inferred.
not_applicable_to: machined joints with holes without local analysis

sensitivity_inputs.modulus_sensitivity_scope: Scale E and G together; deflection/rotation inversely scale, force-controlled nominal stress does not. This is a chosen numerical sensitivity, not a measured material range.

sections.J_model: sum of local circular J, with common twist and no frame contribution
